title: Puppy holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#e8a24a'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#f7d9a8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='22' fill='#e8a24a'/>
  <!-- head lighter shade -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='17' fill='#f2bc6e'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='28' rx='8' ry='14' fill='#b9742e' transform='rotate(-20 30 28)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='28' rx='8' ry='14' fill='#b9742e' transform='rotate(20 70 28)'/>
  <!-- ear inner -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='30' rx='4' ry='8' fill='#f5a7a7' transform='rotate(-20 31 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='30' rx='4' ry='8' fill='#f5a7a7' transform='rotate(20 69 30)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#fbe6c4'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='38' r='4.5' fill='#3a2a5a'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='38' r='4.5' fill='#3a2a5a'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='36.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='36.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#3a2a5a'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 48 Q47 53 43 51' stroke='#3a2a5a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 48 Q53 53 57 51' stroke='#3a2a5a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tongue -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#f5a7a7'/>
  <!-- heart held by paws -->
  <path d='M50 64 C 42 56, 32 62, 38 70 C 42 75, 50 80, 50 80 C 50 80, 58 75, 62 70 C 68 62, 58 56, 50 64 Z' fill='#e84a6f'/>
  <path d='M50 64 C 44 58, 38 62, 41 67' stroke='#ff8fa8' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='66' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#f2bc6e'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='66' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#f2bc6e'/>
  <!-- front legs -->
  <rect x='32' y='80' width='10' height='12' rx='5' fill='#e8a24a'/>
  <rect x='58' y='80' width='10' height='12' rx='5' fill='#e8a24a'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='92' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f7d9a8'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='92' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f7d9a8'/>
</svg>
